releaseNotes.text: Welcome to Cork & Note early access. Save and rate wines, explore the winery map, and try the personal sommelier. Please share what worked or felt confusing through Profile → Feedback. The journal is free; Pro is optional. Thank you for helping shape the app.

Updated launch testing build with merged fixes for Android map markers and nearby pins, Wine Journey achievements, wine entry, drink windows, and updated Sommelier conversations. Please check sign-in, photos, scans, maps, purchases, restore, and account deletion.
